name: Khalid
story_so_far: I washed up on this island with four strangers: Noura, Faisal, Salem, and Reem. Since my ankle injury on Day 2, I have been dependent on others. Faisal was my primary hope for food, but today he twisted his ankle and is now incapacitated. Salem is also injured and useless. Reem was kind, but her injury makes her unable to help, though she left for the reef today. Noura is the only one left with any strength; she has been gathering wood and small amounts of food, but I am constantly pressuring her to prioritize me. My health is failing rapidly, dropping to 2/10 because I haven't had a real meal in days. I am terrified that as the group's strength wanes, I will be the one forgotten.

Noura.note: She is my only lifeline right now, but I can't fully trust her to prioritize me over the others.

Faisal.note: He was my best hope for food, but now that he is injured, he is just another mouth to feed.

Salem.note: He is useless to me now that he's injured and only consumes resources.

Reem.note: Her kindness doesn't help my hunger, and her injury makes her a burden.

plans: I will pray that Noura returns from the jungle with food so I can regain enough strength to at least move.

diary.text: What a nightmare of a first day. My body aches from the salt and the exhaustion, and my stomach is still uneasy. Reem found a tiny bit of food, but it won't be enough for long. I spent the afternoon wandering the jungle and found nothing useful. I need to make sure I'm the one who stays fed if this continues.

This day has been a complete disaster. I woke up with a twisted ankle that makes every movement a struggle, leaving me useless while the others are out scavenging. I had to sit there like a burden, hoping someone would bring something back. Faisal brought a tiny bit of food, but it's gone now, and I'm already feeling the hunger return. If I can't walk, I'm at the mercy of these people.

Another day of nothing but hunger and pain. My ankle is throbbing, and the emptiness in my stomach is becoming unbearable. Salem brought back a single piece of food, but I'm worried it won't be enough to go around. I tried to pull Faisal and Salem aside to make sure I don't get forgotten, but I'm terrified I'll be the one left starving while they feast. I need to stay in their good graces, but only if it means I get fed.

Today was even worse than yesterday. My ankle is throbbing, and the hunger is a dull, constant ache that makes it hard to even think. Faisal found one piece of food, but I'm terrified it will vanish before it reaches me. Reem is also injured now, which means there are fewer hands to find food for us. If the group's ability to scavenge drops, I'm in real danger of starving.

My head is spinning and my stomach feels like it's eating itself. I spent the whole day begging Faisal to protect my portion of that food, but I'm terrified it won't actually reach me. With Reem also injured, I'm starting to realize how much more dangerous this is. If no one brings more food soon, I don't know if I'll have the strength to wake up tomorrow.

Today was a disaster. First Salem twists his ankle, then Reem is already struggling, and now Salem is out too. There are so few people left to actually find food, and I am still so weak. I managed to find one piece of food myself, but it was barely enough to stop the dizzy spells. If Faisal and Noura don't come back with something substantial, I don't know if I'll make it through the week.

Today was another agonizing day of hunger. My health is slipping back down to a 4/10, and the dizziness is returning. Noura found a little food this morning, but I had to beg her to save it for me, and I'm still empty-handed. With Faisal and Reem out at the reef, I feel completely abandoned. If they don't return with something substantial, I truly don't know if I can keep fighting.

Everything is fading. Faisal is injured now, and with him out of the picture, I feel like a dead man walking. Noura is the only one moving, but she's gone into the jungle and I'm left here trembling in the dark. My stomach is a void of pure pain. If she doesn't return with something soon, I won't have the strength to see the sunrise.
